inference_scope: No new confidence intervals or hypothesis tests are introduced. Do not pool matched cells as independent observations.
interpretation_limits: The population-risk-to-empirical-lower gap combines finite-sample empirical optimism, sparse-graph relaxation and finite dual optimization; these summaries alone do not separate them.
The empirical-lower-to-L decrement includes KL calibration and conservative rounding. It is not an estimate of optimization error.
The registered sweep ablation isolates additional multiplier-proposal sweeps on the same frozen data, models and graph at p=0.05; it does not identify the optimization effect at p=0.5.
The separate saved-replicate graph diagnostic concerns p050_K320 replicate0 only and must not be represented as a registered all-replicate ablation.
Class-feasible but fitted-infeasible cases establish a limitation of the chosen witness, not impossibility for every affine learner.
mean_scope: Means average the existing completed runs, including their development-dependent learned classes. Exact rational values are authoritative; decimal copies are display-only.

membership_witness_gap.interpretation: Class feasibility concerns the full Lipschitz decoder class. A fitted-witness failure does not prove that the affine family itself is incapable, or identify training, regularization, norm repair or expressiveness as the cause.
